service.name: Yacht rock band
service.serviceType: Yacht rock cover band for company parties, patios and private events
service.description: A yacht rock cover band playing Doobie Brothers, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates, Toto, Christopher Cross and Michael McDonald in three-part harmony with saxophone, for summer company parties, client appreciation evenings, after-parties and milestone birthdays across Denver and Colorado.

faqs.q: What is a yacht rock band?
faqs.a: A band that plays the smooth end of late-70s and early-80s pop and soft rock: the Doobie Brothers with Michael McDonald, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates, Toto, Christopher Cross, Boz Scaggs and Kenny Loggins. The songs depend on harmony vocals and saxophone, which is why this one carries three voices and a horn. It's booked through Signet Artists in Denver.

While people eat, the ballads play at a level the tables talk across. Once the floor opens it plays like a party band, loud enough to fill a lawn or a ballroom. The band sets the level to the space and the crowd, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number and the set stays under it.

faqs.q: How much space and power does it need?
faqs.a: The four-piece sets up in about 14 by 10 feet on two dedicated 20-amp circuits and needs 90 minutes to set up. The five to six piece needs a little more width. Sound support that's the right size for the venue comes with every booking, and on a patio that's what lets a band fill a lawn.

Yes, and patios and lawns are its natural work. It needs a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it, and we agree a plan for moving indoors with you ahead of time, because Colorado weather turns fast in the afternoon.

faqs.q: Can we add time or ask for a song?
faqs.a: Yes. If the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night, and the band learns one song of your choosing as part of every booking.
